sentence: This project provides pathology services and makes 3-dimensional organoid models for studying mouse and human tissue.
This project studies how the bacterium Selenomonas sputigena invades cells of the gingival tissue and disrupts host biology.
This project uses host-microbe metagenomic sequencing on bronchoalveolar lavage samples to build tools for diagnosing complications after lung transplantation.
This project builds high-resolution retinal imaging tools to study the human retina in health, prematurity and aging.
This project uses mass spectrometry and computational methods to find out how alternative splicing changes cardiac protein composition, structure and function.
This project studies how an adaptor protein and a kinase signaling pathway control vascular lumen size in zebrafish embryos and human vascular endothelial cells.
This project tries to find out how circuits in frontal brain regions handle cognitive and affective processes during decision-making and stress.
This project studies mast cell progenitors in human airway tissue and the signals from epithelial and fibroblast cells that make them proliferate.
This project uses deep learning surrogates to predict where and when resistance to antimalarial drugs emerges and spreads.
This project tests whether excessive carbohydrate modification of heart proteins turns on a growth pathway and causes heart failure.
This project builds a network that gives researchers biosamples and tools to study inflammatory arthritis and related diseases.
This project studies how a protein helps neural cells sense and respond to physical forces during brain development.
This project tries to find out what astacin metalloproteinases do when the nematode Strongyloides stercoralis penetrates host skin.
This project builds a compact, portable, low-cost Positron Emission Tomography system to image Alzheimer’s Disease in outpatient and mobile care settings.
This project designs and tests an epidermal photoacoustic tomography technology to image the brain of awake non-human primates.
This project uses protein engineering to make bispecific T cell engagers that instruct the T cells of patients to kill cancer cells.
This project develops gene-editing tools that reprogram cardiac fibroblasts to prevent adverse remodeling and heart failure.
This project builds statistical and computational tools that separate biological signal from social and environmental structure in large-scale human genetic studies.
This project studies how pathogens set up infections and how the host immune responses act against them.
This project builds a continuous flow device that makes hyperpolarized agents to measure metabolism in cancer cell lines and tumors.
